requirement: A site import survives a dsh restart (interrupted, Continue from the stored parts, no password), a slow uplink (parts step down, then go inline), says its bytes, and installs the slim Claude Cowork package first; an unfinished import is never opened as a workspace, and has a recovery page; and a safe Remove for it, with a sweep of abandoned ones

oracle.ref: PR #1598 (fix); fix evidence: QA on dev (cowork.tracy.site), 21/10/2026: a Joomla 4.4 site of ~180 MB grew to 628 MB with 483 MB of contracts the site-side Claude Cowork install brought (#1568); the import at 38–133 KB/s needed ~1.5 h, a part failed repeatedly on the 120 s PUT limit (#1566), the file count sat still for 30 min (#1567), and a deploy replaced dsh after its drain so status answered RUN_UNKNOWN and the cursor counted 60 min from its first part (#1565). Team report 22/10/2026: an import fails, then the customer opens the app and cannot choose a workspace — / picked the import's accepted seat (claimed before the read, kept after the failure for Retry), whose folder only /provision builds, so dsh answered workspace/invalid-path; Start the agent made an empty skeleton folder through /attach.
oracle.invariant: S1: the cut run answers state error, error interrupted, step reading_files, parts 1, resumable true; its lease file is gone; no password, token or cookie is in the status or on disk; nothing is asked of the site until Continue; both Continue presses get the same new run, which finishes with no sign-in, sends parts 2 and 3 only, and closes one archive with the ETags of parts 1, 2 and 3. S2: the 1.5 h cursor is still held; the idle one and the 25 h one are stale. S3: the part is asked 8 MiB on the PUT road, then 8 MiB inline, and the rest of the read stays inline at 8 MiB (the size never changes within an upload); the read finishes. Every attempt reserves its part number on disk before any call may write under it, so a retry or a Continue after a restart never reuses one, so the archive holds the fresh bytes and the stale PUT lands on a number complete does not list. S4: every progress names the total when the engine told it and none when it did not; the row shows '212 of about 628 MB sent', 'about 84 min left' and 'Sending part 28 (1:35)'; an interrupted run maps to the Continue case p53, or p53.again when the host holds no code. S5: only the upload POST is sent, and the package it carries has no contracts; the URL road runs only when the upload road does not install or this side cannot download the package. S6: only the import → 302 to /new/?tab=tracy:add-site&import=<siteKey>; with a ready site → 302 to /<ready>/; the named path → the same recovery 302, a fetch → 409 IMPORT_NOT_FINISHED, and no seat minted or dsh asked; a stranger still gets /<label>/join; the pointer is cleared (Max-Age=0) and the person lands on the ready site, or on the recovery page when there is none; /agent → 409 {code: IMPORT_NOT_FINISHED, recovery} with no /_host/attach call and attached still false; /api/sites keeps the row with importPending true, importRecovery and agent null even when attached is true; a created site and a finished import carry no flag, the finished one is landed on and its claim is no longer retryable; the built migrated row is not pending. S7: the row is listed with 'Import not finished' and a 'Finish import' link to importRecovery, no 'Start the agent', and the row itself does not open; a row with no agent that is not an unfinished import still offers 'Start the agent'. S8: opening the page starts nothing; a failed read shows its progress with the failed step and its action leads to the form with the address and admin URL filled from the host, and Start sends retryOf <failed run>; an interrupted read offers Continue, which starts {siteKey, platform, retryOf} with nothing typed; a running read is followed (Follow it) with no claim or start; RUN_UNKNOWN says Tracy has no record of the import and starts nothing; an unreadable answer offers Check status, which asks again. S9: idle → 200 {removed: true, artifactsKept: 0}, the host asked hold then forget, the row and its seats gone, the open multipart aborted and the archive deleted inside the site's prefix, the key outside it untouched; running → 409 IMPORT_RUNNING, unreachable → 503 HOST_UNAVAILABLE with release asked: row and seat kept, removing_at null, nothing stored deleted, and a later Remove succeeds; while held the claim, /provision and /agent answer 409 IMPORT_REMOVING, no /attach, and a second Remove IMPORT_REMOVING; provision vs Remove: exactly one wins every round; finished import and built site → 409 NOT_UNFINISHED_IMPORT, editor → 403, the host never asked. S10: running → 409 RUN_ACTIVE, nothing held; held → start and retryOf throw SiteHeld, no run opened, the hold in holds.json, still held after a restart, a start runs again once released; before/during/after: exactly one of hold and start wins; a part an hour ago refuses a 6 h 30 quiet hold (RECENT_ACTIVITY) and passes a 30 min one; forget refuses an unheld site, then removes the site's runs (memory and runs.json), cursor and code, answers the upload key, leaves another site's cursor, lifts the hold; a hold lapses after HOLD_TTL_MS; only a fresh, unreplayed signature over the exact body with a secret passes. S11: 6 h 31 min removed through hold then forget, 6 h 29 min kept; running, recent and unreachable kept as IMPORT_RUNNING, IMPORT_RECENT, HOST_UNAVAILABLE with the row, seat and no mark left, then removed once the host is quiet; a fresh claim press keeps it; sweepClaims releases nothing of it. S12: sweep ≥ RUN_TTL_MS ≥ UPLOAD_IDLE_MS and the numbers 6 h 30, 6 h, 6 h (red when the sweep is lowered to 5 h); the recovery page's Remove asks first, removes, shows the removed line and an empty form, says IMPORT_RUNNING and 'try later' with Retry still there, and is absent from the plain form; a claim refused IMPORT_REMOVING shows its sentence; My Sites' Remove is an owner's only, asks first, calls the one door and rereads the list, and says a running read in its dialog. S13: running → 409 IMPORT_RUNNING, unreachable → 503 HOST_UNAVAILABLE, row, seat and no mark left; idle → 200 {removed, host, repo: false, sessions, seats}, row gone, the host asked hold, hold+release, hold+forget and never the teardown; a finished import is torn down by the plain go-live teardown and the add-site host is never asked; My Sites reads 503 HOST_UNAVAILABLE as a refusal ('try again later'), IMPORT_RUNNING as 'still copying', other 5xx stay unknown; the two sentences exist and name no code in vi, de, it, fr, nl, zh, es and en. S14: every store delete happens while held, the row is gone before forget, the host is never released and a start afterwards is refused (tombstone until HOLD_TTL_MS); a failing transaction answers 503 REMOVE_INCOMPLETE with the row, seat, mark and hold kept and nothing stored deleted, a second Remove IMPORT_REMOVING, and once the mark is stale the Remove finishes; /claim with a read running → 409 IMPORT_RUNNING with nothing deleted, idle → {released: true} through hold then forget; with the default moved, only dsh.test (the row's host) is asked and IMPORT_RUNNING refuses; an unknown host → 503 HOST_UNAVAILABLE, no host asked, nothing deleted, and the sweep keeps it as HOST_UNAVAILABLE; on the host, forget answers {forgotten: true}, the hold already named the upload key, and start and retry throw SiteHeld after forget. S15: the failing transaction leaves the attachment row and stores nothing deleted; a success deletes the row with the site and the object after; a refusing store is logged with the key and the removal stands; the sweep finishes the stale mark through hold then forget and leaves the fresh one marked and unasked; of concurrent runners exactly one proceeds and the host is asked to hold once.
